prerequisites: Knowledge of C programming is desired to increase the chance of success

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the topics covered in the course.
Design and program algorithms to solve problems using Python.
Use libraries/modules, functions, classes, loops, flow control, lists, tuples, dictionaries, string manipulation, file I/O, regular expressions, etc. as seen during the exercises.

assessment_methods.method: Theory: Written exam during the examination period
Lab: Practical exam on lab PCs during the last lab session(s)

assessment_rules: The overall grade is on a 1-20 point scale for both Theory (YT6037) and Lab (YT6038). For the first examination period, Theory is 100% written exam. Lab consists of a 30% project and a 70% practical exam. For resits, successful partial results for YT6037 and YT6038 can be carried over within the academic year. The second examination period follows the same weighting for Theory and Lab components.
